name: trip-planner
description: Local trip planner: flight tracking, itinerary, lodging shortlist, and Claude agent routines

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,ui --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "uv run --project backend trip-planner web --reload" "uv run --project backend trip-planner worker" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.format: uv run --project backend ruff format backend && uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend
scripts.gen:api: uv run --project backend trip-planner openapi --out frontend/src/lib/api/openapi.json && npm run gen:api --prefix frontend
